summary: A friendly acquaintance/peer in the music-and-nightlife scene (shares contact pics, event/photo banter, attended an "isa" event) who later came to the owner for Instagram account services. In July 2026 he asked for help acquiring the IG handle @muvitrecords and was quoted $1,200 via the owner's username-claim contact with a ~3-day turnaround; he said "bet" but there's no confirmation he paid or that the handle was delivered. In August 2026 he flipped to pitching a business partnership — a deck for taking over the US DJ social-media-management market with his contact in Colombia — and followed up on 2026-09-10 asking if the owner ever reviewed it. Open loop: the owner promised to hit him back about the deck and hasn't; also worth confirming whether the @muvitrecords claim ever went through.
